example_prompt: Can you make the website theme into this brand #224248
flow: Ask Luna planner for a complete premium semantic color family.
Validate every HEX and force primary/heading/buttonPrimary to the exact user HEX.
Repair accessibility/separation failures using deterministic premium fallback values.
Persist the complete family as My Brand and map it into component design tokens.
Pass the exact stored brand palette into publish/export/live compiler.
guardrails: WCAG-style 4.5 text contrast repair for key text/button pairs.
No named-theme operation for an explicit HEX rebrand.
Deterministic fallback if Luna omits or returns invalid palette values.
Dark/image hero contrast override remains authoritative.
